title: 2021-22 Panini Prizm Ice Prizm #48 Josh Hart New Orleans Pelicans Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2021-22 Panini Prizm sports trading card features Josh Hart from the New Orleans Pelicans. The card is numbered 48 and has an Ice Prizm variety, making it a unique addition to any collection. The card is part of the base set and is a great opportunity for fans of the National Basketball Association (NBA) to show their support for their favorite team and player.

The card is manufactured by Panini and is not autographed. It is perfect for basketball enthusiasts and collectors who are looking for a high-quality trading card to add to their collection. With its amazing features and set, this card is a must-have for any serious collector.
